function decode(string $raw): array
{
    try {
        return json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    } catch (JsonException $e) {
        throw new RuntimeException("bad payload: {$e->getMessage()}", previous: $e);
    }
}

function groupBy(array $rows, callable $key): array
{
    return array_reduce($rows, function (array $carry, array $row) use ($key): array {
        $carry[$key($row)][] = $row;

        return $carry;
    }, []);
}

final class UserRepo
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PDO $db) {}

    public function find(string $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('select id, email from users where id = :id');
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);

        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }
}

interface Handler
{
    public function handle(Request $request): Response;
}

final class JsonHandler implements Handler
{
    public function handle(Request $request): Response
    {
        $payload = $request->body() ?? [];

        return new Response(200, json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }
}

final class Pipeline
{
    /** @var list<callable(mixed): mixed> */
    private array $stages = [];

    public function pipe(callable $stage): static
    {
        $clone = clone $this;
        $clone->stages[] = $stage;

        return $clone;
    }

    public function process(mixed $payload): mixed
    {
        return array_reduce(
            $this->stages,
            static fn(mixed $carry, callable $stage): mixed => $stage($carry),
            $payload,
        );
    }
}

function route(string $method, string $path): Response
{
    return match (true) {
        $method === 'GET' && $path === '/health' => Response::ok(['ok' => true]),
        $method === 'POST' && str_starts_with($path, '/drills') => createDrill(),
        $method === 'GET' && preg_match('#^/users/(\\d+)$#', $path, $m) === 1
            => showUser((int) $m[1]),
        default => throw new RouteNotFound("{$method} {$path}"),
    };
}

final class CsvReader implements IteratorAggregate
{
    public function __construct(private readonly string $path) {}

    public function getIterator(): Generator
    {
        $handle = fopen($this->path, 'rb');
        $header = fgetcsv($handle);

        try {
            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) {
                yield array_combine($header, $row);
            }
        } finally {
            fclose($handle);
        }
    }
}

readonly class Money
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $cents,
        public string $currency = 'USD',
    ) {}

    public static function fromArray(array $row): self
    {
        return new self(
            cents: (int) ($row['cents'] ?? 0),
            currency: $row['currency'] ?? 'USD',
        );
    }

    public function plus(self $other): self
    {
        return $this->currency === $other->currency
            ? new self($this->cents + $other->cents, $this->currency)
            : throw new DomainException('currency mismatch');
    }
}

function transact(PDO $db, callable $work): mixed
{
    $db->beginTransaction();

    try {
        $result = $work($db);
        $db->commit();

        return $result;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $db->rollBack();

        throw new RuntimeException('transaction failed', previous: $e);
    }
}
